input.summary: Add a 90-day transition assistance period and a 30-day outside date for delivery of funds, Receivable Files and records on Servicer resignation or termination.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 7.5 requires cooperation but sets no minimum assistance period and only an open-ended as-soon-as-practicable delivery date, so we have added our fallback position: at least 90 days of transition assistance and delivery of the funds, Receivable Files and records within 30 days of the effective date of resignation or termination.

ops.oldText: On its resignation or termination, the Servicer will cooperate with the Issuer, the Owner Trustee, the Indenture Trustee and the Successor Servicer in effecting (i) the termination of its rights and obligations under this Agreement and (ii) an orderly transition of such rights and obligations to the Successor Servicer.
ops.newText: On its resignation or termination, the Servicer will cooperate with the Issuer, the Owner Trustee, the Indenture Trustee and the Successor Servicer in effecting (i) the termination of its rights and obligations under this Agreement and (ii) an orderly transition of such rights and obligations to the Successor Servicer, and will provide such transition assistance for at least ninety (90) days after the effective date of its resignation or termination.
